Name: Adventurer's Guild Extra Shop
Author: RitzyGen
Description:
Just a custom location + shop [s]tile framework[/s] mod. Also uses content patcher [s]json assets[/s] to add in more items. I might make more in the future.
Adds a shop behind the Adventurer's guild.

[size=4]Requirements: [s]Json assets, Shop tile framework[/s], Content Patcher, And SMAPI[/size].



This mod is only on nexus, by user RitzyGen. Please do not upload to any other sites.
Do [u]NOT[/u] use my mod to train AI!!


[size=3]Big thanks to xNytax for helping me with this mod![/size][size=3]
Also thanks to boyfoy for making a recolor for this mod!
Thanks to KiingEggy, for also making a recolor for this mod!
Thanks to FellowClown for the spritesheets for Poinsettia, and also HouseBoat tilesheet!

[/size][size=5]when downloading the mod, please download EITHER the main file, or a recolor file. the recolor files work on their own, and downloading multiple at once may break the mod.[/size]

[size=4]Install instructions:
move the downloaded .zip into your Stardew Valley/mods folder, and unzip the file.

Events so far:
v
[size=3][spoiler]
Passerby Intro event: Takes place in Passerby Cemetery, Needs to be a day that is NOT a festival day.
Sunshine fight event: Takes place in Passerby Cemetery, Needs to be a day that is NOT a festival day, starts at 8:00 pm In-game time.
Vanilla Intro event: Takes place in the Town, Needs to be a day that is NOT a festival day, starts at 8:00 pm in-game time, Player must have received "landslide cleared" letter.
Sock's 2 Heart event: Takes place at the Beach. Must have 2 hearts of friendship with Sock, Must NOT be a festival day, Weather must be sunny.
Poinsettia Adventurer Guild event: Takes place in the Adventurer's Guild, must NOT be a festival day, Season must be winter, starts at 12:00 pm in-game time, Weather must be rainy.
[/spoiler][/size]

[/size][size=5]If this mod is added to an in-progress SVE playthrough,  the player will need the Destroyable Bushes mod to clear the path to it, since SVE plops a bush right in front of it.[/size]
[size=3]Here is the link for Destroyable Bushes -> [/size][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6304]Link
[/url]

[/size][size=2]Current languages: english[/size][size=4], [/size][size=2]mandarin(translation available)[/size][size=4]
[/size][size=2]I am open to suggestions, and ideas for new items if you have any :)[/size][size=4]
[/size][size=2]should be compatible with SVE.[/size][size=4]
[/size][size=2]May not work on mobile :([/size][size=4]
[/size][size=2]Compatible with Passerby Cemetery by Fellowclown[/size][size=3].
[/size][size=2]I will add more events after I take a break.[/size][size=3]

[/size]
you can get a weapon called "greensword" from the shop when the weather is green rain.
